notes.title: Train Station Renovation - Germany DLC Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello Renovators!

We are happy to announce that soon you will be able to renovate completely new stations in the Germany DLC! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37336629/f5800c7319a5f58b2e22dab9376fcf2e6e2afb1c.png

You've asked many times on Steam, Discord and Facebook whether we are planning to create a DLC for the game and we are happy to answer you officially now - yes, we are! Your dedication to your tasks as renovators is admirable and we simply couldn't do without giving you a chance to have some more fun in Train Station Renovation! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1610540/Train_Station_Renovation__Germany_DLC/

In this particular addition you will be able to renovate 6 additional stations that were inspired by stations you can find in Germany - hence the title of the DLC. It is also our nod to our great TSR community from which many of you come from Germany itself! Renovators - a new chapter in your career will begin soon!

notes.title: With a train to a Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Hello Renovators!

Happy New Year 2021 to all of you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33426656/49f135e42d256133c8fd717aa02d9f0b4de001e5.png

Look at that! The train awaits you, very soon leaving for a fantastic station - New Year. 

That station might be something new and unknown but it definitely will bring forth many possibilities and opportunities for you. It's always like that with new beginnings - they might be a bit scary but at the same time they're exciting, promising to be full of great moments. 

We are all going to ride that train and we hope that the journey will be as pleasant as possible. And wherever this train will take us in 2021 we would like to wish you the best year in your life. Let 2021 be a great year for all of you and for now... 

...well, it is a party train for the moment! Have fun! 

Best regards,
Train Station Renovation Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33426656/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

notes.title: Merry Christmas from Train Station Renovation Team!
notes.content:
Hello Renovators!

Festivities are upon us and we would love to wish you all the best!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33426656/677ad0e8c18bd27dee2dd58a6171dbe70858e793.png

"Yes, of course, we are hard at work renovating the station. No, we are absolutely not spending our valuable work time by building snowmen everywhere we go. That's a false accusation!"

...okay, perhaps we have made one snowman... or maybe two. But can you blame us? Renovating stations is a hard work and at a day like today we just needed to do something for ourselves. What we didn't expect is to find presents at this station seemingly waiting for us! 

...suppose Santa Claus thought we did a good job with all the renovation work and decided to leave us some presents to spread the Christmas cheer around. Wonder what did we get? 

We hope that your Christmas will also be full of cheer, merriness and happiness! May your present be all great and fancy and your Christmas tree always illuminate your path! And most of all we would love to wish you Merry Christmas among your loved ones! 

Merry Christmas!

Best regards
Train Station Renovation team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33426656/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/914010/Train_Station_Renovation/

notes.title: Vote for Train Station Renovation! - The Steam Awards
notes.content:
Hello Renovators!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33426656/8b2323523f46da782609bfff00190c63f5387341.png

We are happy to announce that Steam Award Nominations are live and we would like to invite you all to participate in the event and vote for our game!

Many of you have told us that you find the gameplay in Train Station Renovation to have a particularly calming effect. Some of you were even quick to say that it's almost zen-like and there's nothing better to do in the cold evening after work or particularly tiring day to sit back and fire off Train Station Renovation. Fulfilling different game tasks surrounded by the vicinity of the beautiful old station and reviving them to their former glory seems to be a great way to take a breather after a vexing day. 

As that is the case - we believe that you might be interested in voting for our game in the "Sit Back and Relax" category. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33426656/68021c78067410de4b52184265a5e2dd15e132a9.png

You can vote through the main page of the game right here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/914010/Train_Station_Renovation/

Additionally, we would really appreciate if you could consider giving your vote for Car Trader Simulator in the "Outstanding Story-Rich Game" category. The game features a fully-fledged campaign consisting of three different paths with 27 missions, well written storylines that will let you feel like and become a true American Car Trader. You'll be also able to select whether you prefer to align yourself with mafia or work closer with Police!  

Make sure to check other options and vote for different categories! Perhaps you believe that our games can be voted in other categories too?

Best regards,
Train Station Renovation team

notes.title: Quick Update 1.0.0.2p
notes.content:
Hello train fans

We love your commitment and how are you reacting on Train Station Renovation - First Job! You are giving us a lot of feedback and what is more importantly - you are reporting bugs! A lot of them! What we are doing with reported bugs? We fix them, naturally! 

Today we are planning to release a new version of the game -  1.0.0.2p  will contain fixes and adjustments. Here are most important changes and fixes:

The most reported bug is about a problem with launching a game - we believe we fix this one - but as always - we are counting you will confirm this by downloading update with fixes!

We also made some optimizations and fixed other reported bugs! Or more accurate is to say that we believe so! Now our game should perform better! 

We also make some tweaks and adjustments here and there so the game should be better balanced and fair! For example broom  and how much it is cleaning at one sweep!

Thank you for positive energy, enjoying our game and ongoing bug reports! 
We hope that on 30th April we will release bug free game, thanks to you and your effort! 

Quick List:
-Game Crashes - fixed
-Broom - Improved swept 
-Further optimization


If there are more bugs, please keep us informed! We are doing all we can in order to give you the best game ever!

Best Regards,
